title: Festival of Hearts

facts.statement: The February 2010 developer blog update covered the Festival of Hearts event, and the blog post promised information on it and on new content in development.
facts.quote: Theres cool information on the Festival of Hearts and new stuff that is in the works.

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts TCG bundle offer was available only until the Festival of Hearts ended.
facts.quote: Cette offre spéciale terminera avec la fin du Festival des Cœurs

facts.statement: During the Festival of Hearts, heart flowers bloom and produce magical petals that can be collected.
facts.quote: the magical petals that can be collected from the heart flowers that bloom during the festival

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts is when Cudipon can be found in the Joyful Valley, and the magic petals he studies come from flowers that bloom during it.
facts.quote: Tu peux trouver Cudipon dans la Vallée Joyeuse quand le Festival des Coeurs commence.

facts.statement: The annual Festival of Hearts has returned to Merry Vale, celebrating the legend of Rylan and Arianna.
facts.quote: The annual Festival of Hearts has returned to Merry Vale.

facts.statement: The festival offers daily quests, Members Only quests, and Station Cash and Coin Shop items and outfits, with more items promised the following week.
facts.quote: There are daily quests, Members Only quests and Station Cash and Coin Shop items and outfits

facts.statement: Some Marketplace and Coin Shop items may be inspired by Stone Heart's annual appearance.
facts.quote: There may even be some items in the Marketplace and Coin Shop inspired by Stone Hearts annual appearance.

facts.statement: The annual Festival of Hearts returned to Vegalegre, celebrating a old love story between the pixies Rois and Araiana.
facts.quote: El festival anual de Corazones ha regresado a Vegalegre.

facts.statement: The festival's content included daily quests, members-only quests, Station Cash items, Coin Shop items, and new outfits arriving the following week.
facts.quote: Hay misiones diarias, misiones exclusivamente para miembros, al igual que artículos de Station Cash

facts.statement: The annual Festival of Hearts returns to Joyful Valley and celebrates the old love story of the pixies Valentin and Arianna, whose special flower still blooms there.
facts.quote: Le Festival annuel des Cœurs est de retour dans la Vallée Joyeuse.

facts.statement: During the festival there are daily quests, members-only quests, Station Cash and Coin Shop items, and new outfits.
facts.quote: Tous les jours, il y a des quêtes, des quêtes réservées uniquement aux membres, des objets de Station Cash et dans le magasin de pièces, et des nouvelles tenues!

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts event launched in Free Realms for the PS3 on the day the news post was published.
facts.quote: The Festival of Hearts launched in Free Realms ® for the PS3 TM today!

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts event launched in Free Realms for the PS3 on the day of the post.
facts.quote: The Festival of Hearts launched in Free Realms ® for the PS3 TM today!

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts returned to Merry Vale as a seasonal celebration of love, friendship and kindness, with daily quests and members-only quests.
facts.quote: Merry Vale is once again celebrating the Festival of Hearts!

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts returned to Merry Vale and is a celebration of love, friendship and kindness, with daily and members-only quests.
facts.quote: Merry Vale is once again celebrating the Festival of Hearts!

facts.statement: Free Realms ran a Festival of Hearts event with new themed items that were showcased in a community webcast.
facts.quote: Check out the fantastic new Festival of Hearts items in this exclusive walk through!

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts event was to come online after the update's testing was completed, at the same time as the servers.
facts.quote: The servers and the Festival of Hearts will be online as soon as we complete our testing.

facts.statement: The annual Festival of Hearts has begun in Merry Vale, celebrating a legend of love between the pixies Rylan and Arianna.
facts.quote: The annual Festival of Hearts has begun in Merry Vale.

facts.statement: The festival offers a daily prize wheel, daily quests, Members Only quests, TCG bundles, new pets, and Station Cash and Coin Shop items and outfits such as King and Queen of Hearts outfits.
facts.quote: There is a daily prize wheel, daily quests, Members Only quests, TCG bundles, new pets

facts.statement: Free Realms was to kick off the Festival of Hearts, a month-long event celebrating love, friendship and kindness, in the week of February 8, 2010, with themed events, daily social activities and storyline quests.
facts.quote: a special month long event that celebrates love, friendship and kindness

facts.statement: The Festival of Hearts event was live in Merry Vale starting with the February 12, 2010 update, with the clueless scientist Cudip helping players uncover the secrets of love.
facts.quote: Merry Vale is celebrating the Festival of Hearts! However, not all is hugs and kisses.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This is a short 2010 news stub on the official Free Realms site pointing players to the latest developer blog entry, titled 'February Update and the Festival of Hearts'. It confirms the Festival of Hearts was featured in February 2010 and that the blog covered upcoming work, but gives no concrete details itself. The relative post date ('3 days, 15 hours ago') cannot be converted to an exact date from the capture alone.

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New? (French post: Un Paquet JCC du Festival des Cœurs)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language SOE news post announcing a limited-time Festival of Hearts Trading Card Game bundle. It lists the bundle's contents (booster packs, promo cards and a loot card for the Emo Raptor), says the offer ends with the Festival of Hearts, and explains that it is bought from the Marketplace with Station Cash. The page gives no date beyond 'Posted 1 year, 3 months ago' relative to the capture.

article_summaries.title: Meet Cudip
article_summaries.summary: A Free Realms news post introducing Cudip, an NPC found in Merry Vale during the Festival of Hearts, who experiments with magical petals collected from heart flowers. He asks players to volunteer for sample collection and gives a small reward each time, so players are told to speak to him every day. The post gives no exact date beyond 'posted 3 days, 16 hours ago' relative to capture.

article_summaries.title: A la Rencontre de Cudipon (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A French-language Free Realms news post introducing Cudipon, an NPC who appears in the Joyful Valley (Vallée Joyeuse) during the Festival of Hearts. He experiments on magic petals picked from flowers that bloom during the festival and asks players to volunteer for sample collection, rewarding them with small gifts for each collection help. The post is dated only relatively ('1 year, 3 months ago' at the 2011-06-04 capture), so its exact date is unknown.

article_summaries.title: The Festival of Hearts Returns
article_summaries.summary: SOE's news post announces the return of the annual Festival of Hearts in Merry Vale, a seasonal event tied to the legend of the pixies Rylan and Arianna and a dark creature called Stone Heart. It lists daily quests, Members Only quests, and Station Cash and Coin Shop items, and explains how to reach the festival via the Merry Vale Warpstone. The post gives no exact dates, prices or rewards.

article_summaries.title: El Festival anual de Corazones ha Regresado (Free Realms - What is New?)
article_summaries.summary: A Spanish-language official news post announcing the return of the annual Festival of Hearts in Vegalegre, with its love story of the pixies Rois and Araiana, daily and members-only quests, Station Cash and Coin Shop items, and new outfits arriving the following week. It also describes the villain Stone Heart (Corazón Pétreo), who appears when the special flower blooms and whose annual arrival inspires some Cash Shop and Coin Shop items. The page gives no exact post date; the relative stamp '4 months, 1 day ago' against the 2011-06-04 capture implies about early February 2011, which is an inference.
